head: VHS camcorder app for iPhone records retro 90s video looks
dek: VHS Camcorder: 90s Retro Cam turns the iPhone into six old cameras, from a 1994 VHS camcorder and a 2004 Mini DV to Super 8 film, night vision and a CCTV deck, for a one-time $4.99. It was #43 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 19 November.
details: The look is recorded into the video as you shoot instead of added later: VHS with colour bleed and a rolling tracking band, Super 8 at 18 frames a second with dust and light leaks, green night vision, a black-and-white CCTV deck with a timecode. It has a record button with a beep, a power zoom, a button to throw the tracking off, date stamps you can set back to 1900, titles in six colours, fades and eleven camcorder-style effects. You can also dub clips from your photo library onto tape and play your tapes back on a virtual CRT TV. The listing says it collects no data and has no subscription; it's made by developer Efuare Okougbo and came out on 1 October.
where: App Store, iPhone and iPad, $4.99 one-time, iOS 17 or later
means: If you like the home-video look of the 90s and 2000s, you can film it directly instead of adding a filter afterwards.
todo: Search VHS Camcorder: 90s Retro Cam on the App Store; it's a paid app with no free trial mentioned in the listing.
